_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: flows list
cli_commands.description: List every discovered flow under the configured root

cli_commands.name: flows explain
cli_commands.description: Print the typed flow plus its latest verification status

cli_commands.name: artifacts status
cli_commands.description: Inspect the on-disk generated/ tree for one flow

cli_commands.name: artifacts generate
cli_commands.description: Generate or regenerate one flow's artifacts (or every flow in a scenario)

cli_commands.name: artifacts clear
cli_commands.description: Remove one flow's generated/ tree (or every flow in a scenario)

cli_commands.name: artifacts generate --scenario
cli_commands.description: Generate artifacts for every flow inside one scenario

cli_commands.name: artifacts clear --scenario
cli_commands.description: Clear artifacts for every flow inside one scenario

cli_commands.name: verify run
cli_commands.description: Regenerate verification artifacts for every flow

cli_commands.name: scenarios list
cli_commands.description: List every scenario discovered under the Vrooli root with its flow count

cli_commands.name: scenarios get
cli_commands.description: Show one scenario with its discovered flows

cli_commands.name: runs show
cli_commands.description: Show one verification run (with counterexample on failure)

cli_commands.name: settings get
cli_commands.description: Print the local principal's UI/CLI preferences

cli_commands.name: settings set
cli_commands.description: Update one or more UI/CLI preferences (key=value pairs)
